defective_pattern: Creating or dumping ad-hoc test, debug, data-cleaning, or execution scripts directly into the repository root folder.
why_defective: Pollutes the top-level repository tree, contaminates Git working tree status, risks accidental commits of transient test files, and violates the 4-tier project taxonomy.
observed_symptoms: Untracked .py, .sh, or .sps files appearing in git status at the repository root
Ad-hoc test scripts accumulating in root directory instead of tests/ or scratch/
corrective_remedy: Place scripts in their canonical directories: (1) Temporary scratch scripts in <appDataDir>/brain/<conversation-id>/scratch/ or /tmp/, (2) Project analysis in 02_analysis_code/, (3) Suite utilities in .agents/scripts/, (4) Test files in tests/.

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: Target file path for write_to_file or script generation is located directly in workspace root with script extension (.py, .sh, .R, .sps).
